whenToUse: Actions with widely known icons, such as share, save, or delete.
Space is tight, as in cards or toolbars.
The same action repeats in every list item.
whenNotToUse: The icon alone doesn't make the meaning clear (use a text button).
The most important action on the screen (use a primary button with text).
It turns a state on and off (use a toggle button).

alternatives.name: Button
alternatives.reason: The meaning must be clear in words.

alternatives.name: Tooltip
alternatives.reason: Explaining an element that isn't a button.

accessibility: Give it a name with aria-label, and connect the same text as role="tooltip" through aria-describedby.
The tooltip appears on both hover and keyboard focus.
The icon is aria-hidden, and the pressable area stays 40×40px.
Results are announced in a separate status message.
